original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚FCT部长称教师罢工出于政治动机，威胁实施“不工作不付薪”
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦首都区（FCT）部长尼耶索姆·维克称，尼日利亚劳工大会FCT分会发起的教师罢工出于政治动机，并威胁对参与罢工的工人实施“不工作不付薪”政策。维克在阿布贾与安全官员及六个区委员会主席闭门会晤后作出上述表态，并指控劳工领导层未事先咨询相关当局。该报道为单一来源。

key_facts.fact: FCT部长维克称教师罢工出于政治动机
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: THE Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has described the ongoing strike declared by the FCT chapter of the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) as politically motivated

key_facts.fact: 维克威胁对罢工工人实施“不工作不付薪”政策
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: threatening to enforce “no work, no pay” policy against the workers

key_facts.fact: 维克在阿布贾与安全官员及六个区委员会主席闭门会晤后作出表态
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Wike stated this on Friday, October 9, at a press briefing in Abuja after a closed-door meeting with security chiefs and chairmen of the six FCT area councils

key_facts.fact: 维克指控劳工领导层未事先咨询相关当局
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The minister accused the labour leadership of failing to consult relevant authorities before declaring the strike

uncertainties: 罢工是否确为政治动机仅为部长维克单方面声称，尚未获独立证实
该事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
